src.label: Cuban Ministry of Agriculture (CENASA) — on importing and exporting pets, dogs and cats (9 May 2022, in Spanish); Cuban Customs — phytosanitary and veterinary provisions

head: Only dogs and cats vaccinated against rabies, with an official export certificate, may enter.
lines: Cuban Customs lists live animals as prohibited except dogs and cats vaccinated against rabies that carry the official veterinary certification of the country of origin.

CENASA says the origin country's veterinary authority issues an export certificate with the pet's species, breed, name, age, sex, colour and identification (tag, tattoo or microchip), its general health and deworming, and the rabies vaccine's brand, dose, date, validity and lot number.

At the international airport Cuban vets inspect the animal against the certificate and, if all is in order, admit it and take the address where it will stay, because a vet visits the home within 15 days to check its health. A pet leaving Cuba within 30 days can use the same certificate; after a longer stay the export must be arranged through a quarantine clinic.
